response.sql: WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CASE WHEN laps GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(laps AS INTEGER) END) AS avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid > 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) AS avg_of_avg_laps FROM per_driver;

assumptions.assumption: "Upwards of 12" means grid > 12 (strictly more than 12), so grid 12 is excluded.
Each driver's points are summed over only the qualifying result rows with grid > 12, not over all of their results.
Missing laps are NULL or non-numeric text (for example '' or '\N'); those values are dropped before averaging, and a driver with no valid laps is left out of the outer average of average laps.
The outer averages are unweighted means across drivers, with one row per driver.

alternatives.interpretation: "Upwards of 12" is read as 12 or more (grid >= 12), so grid 12 is included.
